root_cause.finding: Scope information is removed before overlap comparison
root_cause.source: _shared_distinctive_phrase topic_words strips numeric and temporal tokens, then intersects whole-reason and whole-residual sets. Two distinct objects with one common facet and two disjoint disclosure intervals collapse into the same overlap. Local clause attachment cannot be recovered from that global bag.

root_cause.finding: Native cosmetic-progress guard is a second consumer of flattened scope
root_cause.first_validation_error: selections[1].residual_need must remove the answered facet rather than retain the target cosmetically, and selections[1].answer_scope must change from partial: use full with a null residual only if the card covers the complete target, otherwise use a contextual reason or remove the selection. If exact scope remains uncertain, change selections[1] to a contextual reason with answer_scope=null and residual_need=null, or remove that complete selection
root_cause.implication: Fixing helper alone does not establish direct partial acceptance: full native parser must preserve and validate the same literal scope distinction before cosmetic-progress fallback.

literal_provable_boundary: Complete explicit different noun phrases locally modifying the same requested facet; no proper-name list, no issuer alias/equivalence inference.
The same disclosed predicate, same clock and same numeric window, one within and the other strictly before its start; or explicit nonintersecting date intervals.
Object/facet/window tokens must be in the actual claimed clause or a locally proven shared modifier; unrelated or negative sentence tokens cannot supply a witness.
not_provable_from_token_presence: Unequal window lengths: within90days overlaps within180days.
Delivery/production/effective windows are not publication/disclosure windows.
A named object only in a negation or another descriptive sentence does not scope an otherwise generic claim.
A one-word adjective difference does not establish two nonoverlapping economic facets; retain conservative rejection.
minimal_repair_boundary: Add a narrow target-derived local scope witness to both overlap and residual-progress decisions. Only exempt the exact object/facet or same-axis disjoint time scope proven. Reject any separate retained-facet claim in the remaining reason; retain whole-word/PIT/typed checks and full native reparse/fallback. No general semantic interpreter or scope-based global stopword removal.

binding_and_limits.baseline_isolation: Exact saved 92ca helper loaded by own module path; native parser common/current. Source module __file__ and code filename stored in results. Not a full isolated checkout.
binding_and_limits.effects: No fresh model/API/network/Signal/Store/LabelStore/research stage execution. Offline scripted caller allows native corrective fallback; second answer deliberately unavailable. Tests prove validation behavior, not fresh author obedience.
binding_and_limits.typed_and_PIT: Their negative controls reject for native type/PIT obligations, not evidence that the overlap helper alone understands those dimensions.
